## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (ShellCheck, shfmt, syntax, Bats)
- [ ] New or changed scripts have Bats tests in `tests/`
- [ ] Lessons follow [docs/style-guide.md](../docs/style-guide.md): fenced and tagged code, expected output, warning + undo step for risky commands
- [ ] Every command in the change was actually run; pasted output is real
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, `.idea/` or `.DS_Store` files
